company_context.executive_quote: Only reproduce a verbatim quotation when present in a verified primary source; include speaker full name, position and source URL. Otherwise use a factual third paragraph without a quotation. Never invent quotations, credentials, project dates or status.

images.image_url: Use a verified HTTPS asset or site-relative local asset; never assume a source image exists.
images.alt_text: Provide factual UA and EN alt text, identifying a logo or illustration as such.
images.rights: Record image origin and permitted usage; do not hotlink an unverified third-party logo or imply a generated illustration is a documentary photograph.
images.fallback: When no cleared photo or logo is available, use an original neutral editorial illustration clearly labelled as illustrative, not an empty card or an invented company logo.
images.rendering: Render image on homepage, all-news, industry card and article with responsive aspect ratio and onerror fallback; validate asset reachability and broken-image behavior before release.

editorial.navigation: Every published card on home and industry pages must link to a full article derived from the same approved record. No hardcoded demo news in public listings. All nine configured industries must be audited for coverage, valid routing and honest empty states.
